decision: Keep the one-thread child-panic regression ACTIVE under its repaired R2 controller. R1 preserved an import-error reservation before the supervisor or Cargo process began, so it is engineering evidence rather than a scientific observation and does not alter the fixed input or matrix scope. R2 is the highest-value feasible local continuation because it can still resolve the bounded one-worker operational uncertainty. Pipeline completeness remains broader but cannot start before its independent checked-object receipt-semantics protocol gate is met.

categories.assessment: R2 retains the finite parent-versus-worker diagnostic comparison after a controller-only repair. Pipeline completeness remains a broader discovery method but is not yet protocol-ready.

The one-worker panic-observation boundary remains a narrow unresolved operational asset; the R1 incident established no checker observation. A checked-object receipt sentinel could later be shared more broadly, once its input semantics are frozen.
Neither candidate has present evidence requiring an external action. R2 remains local-only and reports infrastructure or control failure without asserting an upstream defect.

R2 reuses the pinned source, existing mutation and existing control/candidate bytes, and changes only the controller import. Pipeline completeness still needs its own producer, adapter and receipt-semantics review before reuse can be justified.

R2 directly repairs the controller-only blocker while preserving the R1 reservation and the original four-cell gate. Pipeline completeness is blocked locally by a scientific protocol gate, not by an external dependency.

candidates.rationale: ACTIVE under committed R2 bindings. Its one recorded R1 reservation is preserved with direct evidence that the missing import raised before run_supervised, without a Cargo/checker process or raw process receipt. The repaired controller, same fixed matrix, source and configuration inputs remain finite and independently validated.

This remains the strongest alternative with broader transferable value, but its producer, adapters, checked-object receipt semantics, independent expected contents and fault rubric are not yet bound in a finite protocol.

blockers.reason: Bind the supported producer and adapters, a twelve-declaration expectation, receipt semantics, fixed faults and finite source/setup/build/tooling/process controls before promotion.
